messages:
alex: FYI partner lab flagged a perf regression when running LLM infer on A100 with CUDA 12.2 + driver 535.12 — 20-30% token throughput drop vs our baseline :warning:

maria: ugh. do we have a simple repro or a minimal benchmark snippet?

alex: short repro attached by partner (summary):
```
python perf_test.py --model small --batch 8 --seq 1024
# baseline on driver 530.x: 160 tok/s
# driver 535.12: 115 tok/s
```
They also noted higher GPU SM utilization and longer kernel times in cuBLAS.

sri: can you paste the nvidia-smi and dmesg snippet? kernel messages sometimes point to ABI mismatches.

alex: nvidia-smi output (sanitized):
```
Driver Version: 535.12
CUDA Version: 12.2
GPU Util%: 98
Mem%: 76
```
no obvious dmesg OOMs.

ben: marketplace impact: our default marketplace image currently bundles driver 535.12 on Ubuntu 20.04 images for A100. if 535.x is the culprit we need to consider pinning to 530.x or offering a 530 pinned channel.

jess: communications ask: partners want a single source of truth on what we'll announce and when. if we change marketplace images we should give at least 72h notice for partner listings & docs.

nvidia-eng: thanks for the signal — we're looking at cuBLAS kernel tweaks in 535.12. early hypothesis: slower GEMM kernel path for certain shapes. we're spinning a micro-bench and will share results by EOD PST.

maria: propose immediate plan:
- canary deploy with driver 530.41 image on our canary cluster (redwood-canary-1)
- run our full perf harness + partner repro suite
- if canary clears, publish marketplace rollback/pinning artifact and patch notes
- schedule partner call after we have root cause

alex: timeline request: canary start today afternoon? ben can you schedule image build and tag? @deploy-bot can you queue a canary with tag `driver-530-canary-3410000000`?

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: `driver-530-canary-3410000000` -> redwood-canary-1. ETA: 45m. Logs: https://internal.deploy/logs/3410000000

ben: building the image now. I'll also produce a `driver-535-compat` matrix artifact so partners can test both. target finish in 2 hours. tagging owners in the partner channel once ready.

sri: testing matrix we should run (quick list):
- 530.x + CUDA 12.1 (baseline)
- 530.x + CUDA 12.2\- 535.x + CUDA 12.2 (regression)
- ROCm 5.x on equivalent HW for partner SI parity
include perf, correctness, and memory growth checks.

jess: comms: draft note for partners: short description of issue, mitigation (canary/pin), ETA for wider rollout, and a targeted partner call time window. I'll draft and share for review.

alex: agreed. action owners: ben (image + matrix artifact), maria (run perf harness & logs), nvidia-eng (kernel cuBLAS micro-bench), jess (partner comms). target: decision on pin/rollback within 24h.

maria: starting harness now against canary. will paste perf diff and flame graphs to this thread when ready. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: thanks everyone — let's avoid public announcement until partner call is scheduled. will reconvene when logs are in. :phone:
